title: Thimsy ES-DE/nano/emulators.json
description: Legacy: shipped Android builds' per-game emulator choices that ES-DE has no label for (esdeStoreSaveGameEmu, NanoEsdeStore.cpp), written in place, so unknown top-level keys and other games' items survive, and the re-picked game's item is rebuilt as {game, label, am}. From the per-device change on (OA-46; LIBRARY-FORMAT.md 4.10) no build writes it: Android reads it once at migration, and Linux never reads it. Picks are per device, in emulator_config/devices/<id>/picks.json. The 'key' field is described for files a newer writer may have touched; it is no longer written. Unknown fields are allowed here because the file is already in the field. Only the draft-07 keywords devicejson.py validates are used.

version.description: Android forces it to 1 on every write; never relied on.

game.description: ES-DE folder, '/', the path relative to it, case kept, no './'.

label.description: Nano's display label of the emulator.

am.description: Android am start arguments; Android loads an item only when it matches its catalogue.

key.description: The portable key of the same choice that 'am' describes.
